scope: One bounded retained finding-preparation task; no timing, publication, nested agents, or reserved-worktree changes.
criteria: Reobserve the upstream default and retrieve pinned original/default source, relevant history, and bounded upstream/fork related work.

Trace actual ApplicationPartManager producers, feature consumers and retained mutations; document real source-derived cardinality, equality, ordering, duplicates, prepopulation and lifecycle boundaries.
Retain a candidate only if real workload evidence supports material benefit and the surgical implementation preserves the existing observable contracts without a long-lived cache or API change.

If retaining a candidate, add focused native tests exercising real application-part production, and run bounded untimed validation only under current policy and lease/HOLD admission; preserve prerequisite failures without broad rebuilds or custom compiler harnesses.
If materiality or semantics do not justify a candidate, return a concrete no-candidate reason and distinguish source evidence from unexecuted runtime and performance claims.
Persist a compact HANDOFF.json and exact changed-file diff/hash index, leaving all owned native work terminal and all comparisons at zero.
excluded: Benchmark, warmup, timing, allocation or performance counters, profiling, and benchmark-like repeated discovery.
Synthetic large type populations or artificial repeated startup.
Changes outside the F240 private scope, including F208/F214/F200/F201/F345.
Remote execution, publication, commits, pushes, PRs, policy/registry/ledger/lease changes and machine-wide changes.
